purpose: Continue Tiny Tales after Fruit Picnic with a visually and structurally distinct musical light-and-shadow story.

global_rules.narration_visual_sync: Every lyric and effect remains inside the composition that visibly supports it.
global_rules.sound_policy: Visible theatre sounds are effects and never spoken onomatopoeia.
global_rules.motion_hierarchy: One hero shadow transformation, one supporting character response and restrained ambient dust/light.

productions.title: Lumi's Shadow Theatre Surprise | Light and Shadow Song for Kids
